name: VCSL Wine Glasses
description: Four tuned wine glasses rubbed fast and slow, with the fast rubs mapped to higher velocities and the slow rubs to lower velocities.

Fast rubs are mapped to velocities 64–127 and slow rubs to 1–63; the separate release-trigger decay recordings are omitted.
